newsitem.title: USA: New York City seen adjusting budget on Oct 24.
newsitem.headline: New York City seen adjusting budget on Oct 24.

text.p: New York City, which in mid-August told its agencies to come up with $500 million of cuts to close ballooning budget gaps in later years, expects to adjust its 1996-97 fiscal budget around October 24.

"We're still on target timewise," said a city official, who spoke on condition of anonymity. He declined comment on what sorts of cuts might be announced, but cautioned that nothing dramatic might be disclosed.
"Frankly, I don't expect to have a lot of news," he said. "The much bigger news will come in February."
The city, whose fiscal year ends on June 30, typically adjusts its budget twice a year, once in the autumn and once in February.
